confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium-confidence. They rest on crowd-sourced and aggregator estimates (Numbeo, CityCost, almurakib, Oysterlist, Wohin-und-Wann, departly), several undated, and wine is weakest. Wine_glass is inferred from the local beer price, since no reliable 2026 per-glass restaurant figure was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July peak season; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. FX: the 0.6976 value is for 2026-11-03, not the latest observation on 2026-11-19. It was reported by a third-party site as the RBA 4pm Sydney reference, and I could not open the RBA F11.1 table to verify it directly. The official RBA exchange-rates page was not read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Marmaris is a Turkish Aegean resort in Muğla province on the Anatolian (Asian) side. Prices are benchmarked to Turkish coastal resort pricing with a tourist-season premium for July 2026. Region is set to Middle East on the Anatolian geography. Restaurant anchors are based on aggregated Marmaris estimates: beer about 3.0-3.2 USD, cappuccino 2.5-3.7 USD, inexpensive meal 7-10 USD, mid-range meal for two 22-44 USD. Cocktail is based on Bar Street reports of about 5-10 GBP. Wine_glass is set at roughly 1.5x the local beer price because direct evidence was weak. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for resort hostels and hotels in peak season.
